# Field profiles

<!-- Generated by `npm run profiles`; edit scripts/profiles.ts or the guidance files, not this. -->

What a new record of each kind offers, the way a Sinopia template lists its fields. Each is worked out by the editor's own layout code from LC's records (`src/schema/guidance.json`) and the hand corrections (`src/schema/guidance-overrides.json`). The rules are in [which-fields.md](../which-fields.md).

The kinds are checked in this order, and the first that matches a record wins.

| Kind | Defined by | Records measured |
|---|---|---|
| [Serial (online)](serial-online.md) | its Work's type is `Serial`, or its issuance (`bf:issuance`) is `serl`, and its only carrier (`bf:carrier`) is `cr` (online resource) | 500 |
| [Serial](serial.md) | its Work's type is `Serial`, or its issuance (`bf:issuance`) is `serl` | 500 |
| [Map](map.md) | its Work's type is `Cartography` | 500 |
| [Score](score.md) | its Work's type is `NotatedMusic` | 498 |
| [Music recording](music-recording.md) | its Work's type is `MusicAudio` | 500 |
| [Spoken audio](spoken-audio.md) | its Work's type is `NonMusicAudio` or `Audio` | 500 |
| [Video](video.md) | its Work's type is `MovingImage` | 500 |
| [Still image](still-image.md) | its Work's type is `StillImage` | 500 |
| [Collection](collection.md) | its Work's type is `Collection` or `MixedMaterial`, or its issuance (`bf:issuance`) is `mulm` | 473 |
| [Book (online)](book-online.md) | its Work's type is `Text`, and its only carrier (`bf:carrier`) is `cr` (online resource) | 500 |
| [Book](book.md) | its Work's type is `Text` | 500 |
